Public opinion is a powerful mover of public policy. Since 2020, I have served as the Director of the [Laurier Institute for the Study of Public Opinion and Policy](http://lispop.ca) and my interests in public opinion motivate much of the research on the more specific projects you find here. These page collects research that spans these projects.

```{r}
#| label: project-publications

# Locate the project root, then source the shared listing helper.
find_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  dir <- normalizePath(start, mustWork = FALSE)
  while (!file.exists(file.path(dir, "_quarto.yml"))) {
    parent <- dirname(dir)
    if (identical(parent, dir)) stop("Could not locate _quarto.yml")
    dir <- parent
  }
  dir
}
source(file.path(find_root(), "R_scripts", "project_listings.R"))

# Publications whose Zotero tags match this project.
render_project_pubs("Public Opinion")
```
